missables.warning: The only potentially missable trophy. Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter — do it the morning after Down to Earth and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

points: Turn on progress and collectible notifications in Settings, so the game tells you when a counter moves.
Never use cheats on your trophy save: cheats disable trophies and saving.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. There are 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave.
No trophy needs a difficulty setting — there is not one — and no trophy needs online play.
stages.summary: Set the save up right — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
stages.title: Before you start

points: The morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude — keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.
Meet Cal in Feng Shui and start his fishing quests (Baited My Tackle).
Finish an arcade game (Stick Fiddler) — three are on the TV at home.
Start Kenton's treasure dives while he is around (This Was No Boat Accident).
Scan vehicles and WAiNK spots as you travel — 200 vehicle scans and 100 WAiNK scans feed 100%.
stages.summary: The one step in the whole game that can be missed happens here.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — do not skip the balcony

points: Meditate together at every spot from here on — meditating together counts twice toward Positive Mental Attitude.
Start Bret's hunting (Fair Game), Billy's Mudclub jobs (The Lone Rider), Randy's Wish List after the Key Cloner mission (Supply & Demand), and Tyrone's labs after Here, Kitty Kitty (Spin On This!).
Moses and the Scooter Bros app: register cheap cars as you go (On the Spot). Buy garages in the Vice City Real Estate app (Little Boxes).
Rob Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 (Let's Go Bowling).
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and feeds Strangers & Freaks.
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives the Snap Gun (Sneakthief); Credit Check gives the Dye Pack Jammer (Dime on the Dollar).
stages.summary: Once Jason and Lucia are both playable after Coffee Break, most of the list opens.
stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — both characters, everything opens up

points: That's Where The Money Is… opens bank vaults — Maximum Withdrawal, Hot Together and A Classic Blitz Play all live here.
Finish the story: the remaining chapter trophies and the final-mission Gold land as you play.
Keep the pre-finale save untouched — there is no mission replay.
stages.summary: Vaults open, the story trophies land, and the finale closes the campaign.
stages.title: Chapters 4–5 and the finale

points: Work the 100% checklist (A Long Road): all robberies including 8 vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, all Shooting Range gold medals, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.
Finish the six side-story finales: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, the garages and Scooter Bros registrations.
Clean up the free-roam trophies: the jet (Catch Me If You Can), the tank (Challenging Tank), Combat Focus (Gunslinger) and the map fog (The Goodtime State).
The five trophies with unconfirmed methods may pop while you play normally — check their entries for the latest confirmed steps.
stages.summary: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist. This is most of the platinum.
stages.title: After the credits — the long grind, about 100 hours

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, difficulty about 4/10. No online trophies, no difficulty trophies, no mission medals. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off your trophy save.
title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
warnings: Race Against Yago (Yago's Chapter 3 race, part of Strangers & Freaks) is time-sensitive — it shows an hourglass icon. Do it the moment it appears and save first.
Do not push towards the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent.
There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus — keep manual saves at the start of every chapter and one from just before the final mission.
